guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以「追蹤污染物在粗土、細泥與洗液間的分配以評估土壤洗滌」為主軸，依序處理場址分區與代表樣本、乾基污染庫存、洗液負荷與水循環、含水與產品重量、泵送與洗滌能耗。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on Evaluate soil washing by following contamination among coarse soil, fines and wash water, progressing through Site zones and representative samples, Dry-basis contaminant inventory, Wash-water load and recycle, Moisture and product mass, Pumping and washing energy. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
procedure: 只將 a 改成 300 m²，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 25 變成 34 sample cells。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 r 改成 0.70，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 270 變成 210 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將乾基濃度 Cd 改成 150 mg/kg dry，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.14 變成 0.105 kg contaminant。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Cf 改成 700 mg/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 50 變成 75 mg/kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Q 改成 150 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30 變成 37.5 kg/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Q 改成 40 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變成 15 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將濕基含水率 w 改成 0.40，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 700 變成 600 kg dry solids。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 C 改成 3 mg/L，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變成 60 mg/kg dry sample。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 H 改成 20 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.26385 變成 3.01846 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
procedureEn: Change only cell area a to 300 m², holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 25 to 34 sample cells. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only capture r to 0.70, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 270 to 210 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only dry-basis concentration Cd to 150 mg/kg dry, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.14 to 0.105 kg contaminant. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only fine-product Cf to 700 mg/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 50 to 75 mg/kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Q to 150 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 30 to 37.5 kg/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Q to 40 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 20 to 15 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only wet-basis moisture w to 0.40, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 700 to 600 kg dry solids. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only C to 3 mg/L, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 40 to 60 mg/kg dry sample. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only H to 20 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.26385 to 3.01846 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only uC to 0.03, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.072111 to 0.05 relative standard uncertainty. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
evidence: 針對「場址分區與代表樣本」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「污染細粒與粒徑分級」，分別量進料與兩出口的粒徑分布，檢查堵孔、含水與旁通。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「乾基污染庫存」，同步取含水與化學分析樣，核對乾基標記及 mg/kg 單位，再與全部固液出口比對。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「粗細料污染收支」，同步量粗細料乾重和濃度，加入洗液負荷後檢查閉合率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「洗液負荷與水循環」，對齊流量計與採樣時間，以分時段 Q×C 加總，核對總量與單位。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「固液停留與分離」，先扣除無效空間，再用示蹤或批次記錄核對停留時間是否分散。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「含水與產品重量」，保存稱重、乾燥方法及分樣紀錄，對比重複樣並檢查非水揮發損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「處理後浸出驗證」，記錄方法、空白、液固比和乾重，將浸出 mg/L 與換算 mg/kg 分欄呈現。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「泵送與洗滌能耗」，同時讀取液位、流量、壓力和電力，核對實際工作點。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「質量閉合與未知去向」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
evidenceEn: For Site zones and representative samples, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Contaminated fines and size classification, Measure feed and both outlet size distributions, checking blinded apertures, moisture and bypass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Dry-basis contaminant inventory, Collect moisture and chemical samples together, verify dry-basis labels and mg/kg units and reconcile all solid and liquid outlets. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Coarse-fine contaminant balance, Measure dry masses and concentrations of both solids and include wash-water load in closure checks. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Wash-water load and recycle, Align flow-meter and sampling timestamps; sum interval Q×C and check totals and units. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Solids-liquid residence and separation, Subtract inactive volume, then compare tracer or batch records to detect a broad residence-time distribution. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Moisture and product mass, Retain weighing, drying method and subsampling records and compare duplicates while checking non-water volatile loss. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Post-treatment leaching verification, Record method, blanks, liquid/solid ratio and dry mass; display leachate mg/L separately from converted mg/kg. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Pumping and washing energy, Read levels, flow, pressure and power together to verify the actual operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Mass closure and unresolved pathways, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
pitfalls: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「場址分區與代表樣本」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
濕料結團讓可回收細粒留在粗料中。 在「污染細粒與粒徑分級」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
將乾基濃度乘濕重會高估污染庫存，且使不同含水批次不可比。 在「乾基污染庫存」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只檢驗粗料而忽略細泥，會遺失污染轉移的去向。 在「粗細料污染收支」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只比較濃度會把稀釋當成污染質量已移除。 在「洗液負荷與水循環」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
把幾何容積當有效容積，會掩蓋短流與未處理區。 在「固液停留與分離」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
用濕重比較處理前後會把脫水誤認為固體去除。 在「含水與產品重量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
浸出液 mg/L 誤標成固體 mg/kg 會改變結論。 在「處理後浸出驗證」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
管道堵塞會提高阻力，固定額定功率不代表固定流量。 在「泵送與洗滌能耗」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「質量閉合與未知去向」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
pitfallsEn: A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Site zones and representative samples flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Wet agglomeration retains recoverable fines in the coarse stream. Mark where this error can enter the Contaminated fines and size classification flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Multiplying dry-basis concentration by wet mass overstates inventory and prevents fair comparison across moisture states. Mark where this error can enter the Dry-basis contaminant inventory flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Testing only coarse solids loses the contaminant transferred to fines. Mark where this error can enter the Coarse-fine contaminant balance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
A concentration-only comparison can mistake dilution for pollutant removal. Mark where this error can enter the Wash-water load and recycle flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Using geometric volume as effective volume hides short-circuiting and untreated zones. Mark where this error can enter the Solids-liquid residence and separation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Comparing wet masses can mistake dewatering for solids removal. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture and product mass flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Labelling leachate mg/L as solid mg/kg changes the interpretation. Mark where this error can enter the Post-treatment leaching verification flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Pipe blockage raises resistance; a fixed motor rating does not imply fixed flow. Mark where this error can enter the Pumping and washing energy flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Mass closure and unresolved pathways flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

courses.summary: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。
courses.summaryEn: The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.
